description: Read-only checklist to run BEFORE you start a demo instance or touch any database, and again after changing the env you will start it with. It reads this repo's env files and the shell (names and hosts, never values) and answers one report: the repo and what will show, where the demo's data would live (database URLs, on this machine or not, and the repo's seed command), hosted caches and queues the instance would share, live keys and services its server could send, message or charge through (the outbound guard covers the window, not the server), the usual dev ports and a free one, the tools a take of the demo's kind needs (ffmpeg for every kind; a browser for web and terminal; Xcode with an iOS Simulator runtime and AXe for ios, or for ios.iphone Xcode, a signing team in its accounts and the phone on a cable; the Android SDK for android, plus its emulator unless android.serial films a running device, and a system image unless android.avd boots the developer's AVD; Xcode's command-line tools and Accessibility and Screen Recording permission for screen), and whether tday.com will take the upload. Each row is ok, check or stop, followed by the lines to tell the developer. tday.com is sent each row's result only, never what it found.

android.description: For kind android: the android options you will pass demo_start (only serial and avd change what is checked)

avd.description: The developer's AVD you will boot: needs adb and the emulator, no system image of its own

serial.description: A running device you will film: needs adb only

brandId.description: The brand, when this token is a person's key rather than a capture prompt's

envFile.description: The env file you will start the demo instance with (e.g. .env.demo), read over the repo's env files and the shell

ios.description: For kind ios: the ios options you will pass demo_start (only iphone changes what is checked)

iphone.description: A real iPhone you will film on a cable (its name, or "" for the only one plugged in): needs Xcode, a signing team and the phone, not a Simulator or AXe

kind.description: The kind of demo you will record, as you will pass it to demo_start (default web)

offline.description: Do not ask tday.com or send it anything

repoDir.description: The repo root (default: the current directory)

name: demo_check
title: Check before a demo
